text:
mira: FYI - eu-central GPU pool failing node boot; lots of decrypt errors after last-night KMS tightening. Warm pool sits at 60%.

jess: saw alerts at 03:12 UTC, provisioning loop causing repeated KMS calls.

ops-oncall: bootstrap logs: 
```
2024-03-10T03:11:58Z ERROR boot: kms:Decrypt AccessDenied -> Condition "ForAnyValue:StringLike: kms:CallerAccount" failed
```

security-sys: That condition was applied to block stale cross-account grants. We scoped it to only allow known account ids. Maybe ephemeral STS principals don't match.

mira: Can we do a targeted key-policy change to accept aws:PrincipalTag for the lifecycle tag instead? Safer than blanket rollback.

jess: We don't currently attach the lifecycle tag to assumed-role principals during our join flow. The grant flow is missing principal tagging.

deploy-bot: infra/warmpool-join failed (run 10321).

ops-oncall: Short term options: 1) temp key policy revert (fast), 2) add explicit grant for infra-join-role (scoped), 3) update join flow to propagate principal tag (longer).

security-sys: Prefer option 2 for now. I'll create a short-lived grant for the specific KMS key and annotate it for audit.

mira: Also reduce join retry rate? We're seeing NAT GW connection saturations and increased egress billing as nodes hammer decrypt.

jess: Patching bootstrap to exponential backoff (start 1s -> 2x -> jitter cap 45s) and release to staging now.

security-sys: Grant created: create-grant id g-12345, scope: arn:aws:iam::222222222:role/infra-join-role (eu-central). Verified decrypt on a test instance.

ops-oncall: After grant + backoff, warm-pool join rose to 88%. Still shy of target but much better. Autoscaler resumed partial fills.

finance-bot: Quick cost note: NATGW egress increased ~0.9 GB/s during the retry window; estimated extra cost ~€120 for 3h. I'll open FIN-492 for formal chargeback.

mira: Can we schedule a follow-up to change the key policy to use aws:PrincipalTag or aws:PrincipalOrgID so ephemeral principals are covered but we keep cross-account guardrails?

security-sys: Yes - drafting proposal: use aws:PrincipalTag/kms-lifecycle with fallback to permit known roles. Will post in #eng-security for review.

jess: I'll add INFRA-1620 to implement principal tag propagation in the join flow and a canary plan. It needs infra + sde infra reviews.

ops-oncall: Also adding a monitor for KMS.Decrypt error rate by key+region so we catch regressions earlier.

mira: Thanks. Short summary for PMs: KMS policy change blocked ephemeral node decrypts -> warm-pool underprovisioned -> retry storm increased NAT GW egress costs. Short-term fix: scoped KMS grant + bootstrap backoff + audit throttle. Next steps: policy change + join flow tag propagation + postmortem + cost reconciliation.

security-sys: Grant teardown scheduled in 36h unless INFRA signals to extend. I'll include audit entries and link FIN-492 + INFRA-1620.

deploy-bot: reminder: infra deploy window 22:00 UTC.

mira: Closing thread once postmortem doc and cost calc are uploaded. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
